title: Temperley–Lieb Towers, Spin Chains, and Scaling Interfaces

items.title: Type-A path spaces and their matrix-unit tower
items.statement: Define admissible paths on the finite graph A_(ell-1), their endpoint path spaces, matrix units, and the prefix-extension tower maps. This is abstract path-tower data; it does not assert a Temperley–Lieb quotient identification.

items.title: Finite-index extremal II1 subfactor data
items.axiom_use: AC is inherited from the concrete von Neumann algebra and faithful normal trace definitions. The finite module frame below is constructed from a specified finite projection model and uses no further choice.
items.statement: Specify II1 factors, their normalized faithful normal traces, a trace-preserving conditional expectation, a finite right-N module projection model with index lambda, and the extremality condition on the two induced traces of N' intersect M.

items.title: The A_(ell-1) path-space tower branches by adjacent vertices
items.statement: Prove the prefix-extension maps on the free path spaces are unital injective algebra maps and that restriction of the endpoint-b path module branches as the direct sum over vertices a adjacent to b, with invalid boundary labels omitted.

items.title: A finite projection model supplies a finite right-N Parseval frame
items.axiom_use: AC is inherited from the subfactor-data definition. The frame is the finite list of projected coordinate vectors and makes no new arbitrary choices.
items.statement: From H = p L2(N)^k and lambda = (Tr_k tensor tau_N)(p), construct a finite Parseval module frame and prove that the sum of its right-N inner-product traces equals lambda.

items.title: Open XXZ spin-half generators and Hamiltonian convention
items.statement: Fix the ordered spin basis, q = exp(i gamma), delta = q + q^(-1), the 4-by-4 local generator, open-chain boundary range, and the Hamiltonian H = -sum_i e_i normalization.

items.title: Open Potts clock-shift Temperley–Lieb generators
items.statement: Give the separate Q = 2, 3, 4 clock and shift matrices, the staggered 2L-site Temperley–Lieb generators, q conventions, loop values, open boundary range, and Hamiltonian normalization.

items.title: Finite diagram tower inclusion and normalized right closure
items.statement: Define TL_n to TL_(n+1) by adding a right vertical strand and define E_n by closing the new rightmost strand with the factor delta^(-1), for delta invertible. State the positivity condition under which the algebraic expectation is a positive conditional expectation.

items.title: A finite-index II1 basic construction has its Markov trace
items.axiom_use: AC is inherited from the subfactor-data definitions. Finite frame sums and all subsequent tower calculations are explicit and use no further choice.
items.statement: From the explicitly specified bounded-coordinate finite module model, construct the first Jones projection and basic construction, prove e_N x e_N = E_N(x)e_N, and derive the faithful normalized corner trace and Markov formula tau_1(x e_N y) = lambda^(-1) tau(yx). Iteration and both adjacent Jones relations remain owner-escalated because their finite-frame and extremality inheritance hypotheses are not yet supplied.

items.title: The open XXZ local 4-by-4 matrix satisfies the Temperley–Lieb relations
items.statement: Verify the local square, both adjacent triple relations on three sites, and disjoint-support commutation for every chain length and the declared q normalization.

items.title: The XXZ generator Hamiltonian has the declared Pauli expansion and endpoint field
items.statement: Expand H = -sum_i e_i in Pauli matrices and telescope the q - q^(-1) difference term to obtain the exact two endpoint boundary field; state that no periodic bond is included.

items.title: The Q = 2, 3, 4 open Potts matrices satisfy Temperley–Lieb
items.statement: Use the finite clock-shift relations to prove the square, adjacent triple, and disjoint-support relations for all three specified matrices, with loop values sqrt(Q) and free open endpoints.

items.title: Right closure is a trace-preserving diagram-tower expectation
items.statement: Prove injectivity, E_n composed with inclusion equals identity, bimodularity, trace preservation, the right-generator Markov value, and positivity when both tower traces are faithful positive traces.

items.title: Normalized right closure preserves the diagram trace radical
items.statement: Define the trace-pairing radical at each rank and prove it is a two-sided ideal and that E_n sends the rank-(n+1) radical into the rank-n radical. This is the local algebraic descent result; it does not identify the radical with the categorical negligible ideal.

items.title: A positive-root quotient tower inherits expectation and path branching under an explicit identification
items.statement: Prove the conditional interface: if the PA-31 root quotient is identified with the trace-radical quotient tower and its retained path matrix units agree with the A_(ell-1) path-space tower, right closure descends and its simple modules branch by adjacent vertices. The actual PA-31 identification is tracked as an open cross-batch check.

title: Temperley–Lieb Towers, Spin Chains, and Scaling Interfaces: Examples and Counterexamples

items.title: The XXZ local generator is not always self-adjoint in the standard spin basis
items.statement: Refute the universal self-adjointness claim with q = exp(i pi/4) in the declared local matrix convention.

items.title: Scaling limits and non-open boundary models remain source-qualified
items.statement: Record the exact source status of finite-size scaling and LCFT/Virasoro limits, and distinguish open chains from periodic, blob, and two-boundary algebras.

items.title: A matrix amplification gives an explicit finite-index II1 inclusion
items.statement: For a II1 factor M, compute the trace-preserving expectation, a finite frame, index k^2, and the basic-construction trace for M tensor 1 included in M tensor M_k(C).

items.title: The q = 1 three-site open XXZ chain has loop value 2
items.statement: Write the two embedded local matrices on three spins, verify their products, and compute the open Hamiltonian normalization.

items.title: The Q = 2, 3, 4 Potts chains use three distinct q normalizations
items.statement: Compute q, delta, and the explicit generators for Q = 2, 3, 4 and verify the free-endpoint Hamiltonian uses 2L - 1 generators.

items.title: Right closure on the five rank-three diagrams
items.statement: Compute E_2 on the five TL_3 basis diagrams and verify the Markov component normalization for delta invertible.
